The '''Ahto Uprising''' was a battle that took place in [[Ahto City/Legends|Ahto City]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Manaan/Legends|Manaan]] after the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Jedi Order/Legends|Order]] and [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Battle of Rakata Prime|defeated]] the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord]] of the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] [[Darth Malak|Malak's]] [[Darth Revan's Sith Empire|Sith Empire]] at the end of the [[Jedi Civil War]]. The battle was fought between [[The Force/Legends|Force]]-[[Force-sensitive/Legends|sensitive]] [[Force Adept|adepts]] allied with the [[Selkath/Legends|Selkath]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Shasa]]'s [[Order of Shasa|Order]], and the remaining Sith forces on Ahto City. The Shasan adepts successfully defeated the Sith that served Malak, who was killed by the former [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] and redeemed [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Knight]] [[Revan/Legends|Revan]].

==Behind the scenes==
The Ahto Uprising was first mentioned in the third part of the [[Planet Hoppers]] article ''[[Manaan: Depths of History]]'', written by [[Cory J. Herndon]] and published by [[Wizards of the Coast]] in [[February]] [[2004]].<ref name="M: DOH 3" /> A [[:Image:Order of Shasa.jpg|image]] depicting the Selkath female Shasa fighting a [[Sith trooper (Sith Empire)|Sith trooper]] during the Ahto Uprising was released in the ''[[Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide]]''.<ref name="Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide">''[[Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide]]'', [[:File:Order of Shasa.jpg|Image]] of Shasa fighting Sith trooper</ref>
